From: Alex Turner <alex.turner@northleaf-payments.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 12 Mar 2028 02:23:00 +0000
Subject: Checkout failures — 2028-03-12 02:14–02:47 UTC (possible downtime)

Hi Marcus,

We experienced a failure window during our peak checkout flow this morning between approximately 02:14 and 02:47 UTC. Checkout calls started returning 500/503 errors and several customer payments failed to complete — we've had a handful of charge disputes open already.

Impact:
- ~12% of checkout requests returned 5xx in that window (internal telemetry)
- Several merchants reported timeouts and subsequent duplicate submissions

Can you confirm whether Redwood observed an availability interruption in us-west-2 at that time and, if so, whether this qualifies for an SLA credit per our contract? We will need the exact outage window and any evidence bundle you can provide (traces/aggregated telemetry) to open this with finance.

I've attached a screenshot of the failing checkout trace and a short list of example request IDs. Please loop in whoever you need; we want to resolve quickly.

Thanks,
Alex Turner
Head of Integrations — Northleaf Payments
alex.turner@northleaf-payments.com

Hi all — preliminary telemetry from the us-west-2 cluster attached.

Summary (initial):
- We see a spike in 5xx responses starting at 02:15:08 UTC and returning to baseline by 02:46:59 UTC.
- Impacted surface: public /v1/checkout endpoints routed to model-serving pool "rt-32g-a" in us-west-2.
- Root cause (initial hypothesis): brief autoscaler hot-loop during a drain/eviction which caused a small window where routing fell back to a degraded pool with elevated error rates.

Attachments included: raw-traces-20280312.tar.gz, slo-calculation-northleaf.xlsx (SLO-slice used to estimate credit). The slo sheet contains the exact SLO definition you've contracted and a provisional prorated credit calculation.

I will continue collecting full trace bundles and will produce an SLA evidence bundle suitable for Finance if Northleaf confirms that's what you need.

-L

Thanks Laura and Marcus — this is helpful.

A few items from Northleaf:
- Please confirm the exact start/end timestamps you will use for the official outage window (Finance requires UTC timestamps).
- Per our contract (Section 4.2), credit is applied pro rata based on the availability delta against the monthly SLO. We'll need the SLO-ready evidence bundle (raw traces, aggregated counts, and the series used for the calculation).
- Do you expect a formal RCA by end of week (Fri 2028-03-16)? We need that timeline for our compliance and merchant communications.

I'm attaching a short invoice snippet showing where credits would be applied on the next billing cycle — happy to share the full billing contact if that helps speed things up.

Alex Turner

Alex — thanks for the patience. Quick status and next steps: 

1) Confirmed outage window (official): 2028-03-12T02:15:08Z — 2028-03-12T02:46:59Z (33 minutes, 51 seconds). This is the window we will use for any SLA calculation.

2) Eligibility: Based on the SLO slice in the attached workbook and our internal aggregation, Northleaf is eligible for a prorated credit. Preliminary calculation: 4.8% of the monthly invoice for the affected service tier (this is provisional and subject to final finance verification).

3) Evidence bundle: raw traces + aggregated metrics + SLO calculation have been uploaded to the Drive link below and to the support ticket RED-20280312-459. This bundle is formatted for Finance review.

Drive (evidence): https://drive.redwood.ai/shared/Northleaf/2028-03-12/raw-traces
Support ticket: https://support.redwood.ai/ticket/RED-20280312-459
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/8372

4) RCA timeline: Laura and SRE will deliver a full postmortem by 2028-03-19 (EOD PT). We'll include causal timeline, mitigation steps taken, and action items to prevent recurrence (autoscaler tuning + pre-warm policy adjustments).

Next steps for Northleaf: please confirm you accept the provisional credit route and whether you want the credit applied against the next invoice or issued as an account credit. Finance will then prepare the formal credit memo.

If you want a quick 30-minute sync with SRE and Finance to walk the bundle, happy to set that up — propose Thu 2028-03-16 16:00 PT if that works.

-Marcus
Marcus Lin
